description:
Should this borrower refinance? Give the current rate, balance and years remaining; returns the new monthly payment, monthly savings, break-even month, net dollar benefit over the years they expect to stay, and a verdict (worth_considering / marginal / not_worth_it). If new_rate is omitted, uses today's market rate from the Optimal Blue locked-rate index for the borrower's credit score and LTV segment.
Price: $0.35 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).

closing_costs.description: Total refinance closing costs in USD (default 2% of balance)

credit_score.description: FICO score — selects the market-rate segment

current_rate.description: Current note rate in percent, e.g. 7.25

ltv.description: Loan-to-value percent — selects the market-rate segment

new_rate.description: Quoted new rate in percent. Omit to use today's market rate.

remaining_years.description: Years left on the current loan (default 30)

years_in_home.description: Years the borrower expects to keep the loan (default 7)

name: calc_refinance
title: Refinance Calculator
